_doc: The Parts of the book. slug is what data/chapters.json refers to in `part`; ordinal sets the order; label is the full display label; short is the compact form used in tight spaces (the site's header bar and sidebar). Loaded by seedParts in build-graph.js and by site/lossy-nav.tsx.
